entities.name: Forum of Azor
entities.description: Monumental public plaza in Ravnica's Tenth District, established by Azor I and endpoint of the Implicit Maze.

entities.name: Azor I
entities.description: Parun of the Azorius Senate who established the Forum and the Guildpact.

entities.name: Azorius Senate
entities.description: Guild that once strictly controlled the Forum.

entities.name: The Bailiff
entities.description: Magically constructed intelligence left by Azor in the Forum's monolith, executor of the Implicit Maze's judgment.

entities.name: Implicit Maze
entities.description: Network of hidden mana paths linking the ten guildgates.

entities.name: Supreme Verdict
entities.description: Azor's judgment delivered when the maze was completed, dangerous to guilds.

entities.name: Isperia
entities.description: Azorius guildmaster who lifted the Forum's magical controls.

entities.name: Zegana
entities.description: Prime Speaker of the Simic Combine who delivered the Fathom Edict.

entities.name: Fathom Edict
entities.description: Address announcing the rebirth of the Simic.

entities.name: Jace Beleren
entities.description: Planeswalker who becomes the new Living Guildpact.

entities.name: Niv-Mizzet
entities.description: Izzet guildmaster who investigated the maze.

entities.name: Lazav
entities.description: Manipulated the maze-runners into turning on one another.

entities.name: Living Guildpact
entities.description: Title given to Jace by the Bailiff.

events.summary: Isperia lifts the Forum's rigid magical controls, reviving it as an open civic space.
events.quote: Isperia — then the Azorius guildmaster — lifted the rigid magical controls over the Forum.

events.summary: Zegana delivers the Fathom Edict announcing the rebirth of the Simic.
events.quote: Zegana announced the rebirth of the Simic under new philosophical principles

events.summary: Jace discovers the Bailiff and learns of the Supreme Verdict; Lazav also speaks to the Bailiff.
events.quote: As Jace left, Lazav also spoke to the bailiff to learn its secrets.

events.summary: The Bailiff pronounces the Supreme Verdict; Jace links the runners' minds to prevent catastrophe and is named the new Living Guildpact.
events.quote: the bailiff named Jace the new Living Guildpact

relations.quote: Commissioned by Azor I following the establishment of the Guildpact
a magically constructed intelligence left behind by Azor himself
manipulated by Lazav to betray the Maze’s true purpose
